reentryContract.description: CONTINUE时 re-entry 到现有 Decision 主链的方式
reentryContract.reentryPath: CONTINUE → interaction.UnifiedEntry → decision.GenerateCandidates(+excludes) → scoring → arbitration → behavior_plan_builder
reentryContract.excludesMechanism: candidate_generator.GenerateCandidatesWithExcludes(excludes) 接收已失败/循环的candidate IDs
reentryContract.scoringReentry: 每轮重新评分，不复用旧score
